instance_model: one WebAssembly.Instance per actor; one independent unshared bounded Wasm32 linear memory and mutable globals per instance

required_exports.memory: private bounded wasm32 memory; min and max declared
required_exports.actor_resume: (fuel:i32) -> i32; must return within enforced compiler-metered fuel budget
required_exports.actor_stack_used: () -> i32; bytes in compiler-owned continuation stack region

host_invariants: Never grant raw cross-actor memory access or pointers through host imports
Enforce bounded unshared Wasm32 maximum before instantiation and actor+tenant aggregate quotas
Compile suspendable calls into explicit continuation frames inside actor-owned linear memory
Do not treat a yield hint or a JS callback as a stack switch: the guest call must return
Fuel bounds require compiler-metered loops/calls; unmetered Wasm is not actor-preemptible
Carry tenant id, actor id, generation, event kind and sequence in priority CONTROL notices
Reject stale actor generations, duplicate/out-of-order mailbox sequences and sends to closed actors
Actor panic terminates only the actor on recoverable trap; a fatal worker fault may terminate the entire tenant
Never claim browser portability solely from a Node V8 worker test

cases.name: Independent Wasm32 memories
cases.expected: Two actors mutate address 0 independently and report independent values

cases.name: Logical stack continuation
cases.expected: Suspend inside a nested call, return WAITING_IO, then resume with live locals preserved without Wasm native stack switching

cases.name: Fuel fairness
cases.expected: Metered busy loop yields within budget and sibling mailbox makes progress

cases.name: Mailbox wake and FIFO
cases.expected: WAITING_MAILBOX actor receives monotonic sequence, wakes and processes FIFO

cases.name: Actor trap containment
cases.expected: Trapping actor reports fault and healthy siblings continue

cases.name: Stale generation fencing
cases.expected: After restart older ActorRef generation cannot deliver mail

cases.name: Memory and stack limits
cases.expected: Reject oversized declarations before allocation and report stack/arena overflow without corrupting sibling

cases.name: Non-cooperative guest
cases.expected: Uninstrumented guest is rejected or tenant watchdog kills worker; do not claim actor-only preemption

cases.name: Cross-host parity
cases.expected: Equivalent statuses and state in Node worker_threads and browser Worker (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit)
